examples.arabic: التلاجة مش شغالة و المية في كل حتة
examples.english: The fridge is not working and the water is everywhere.
examples.transliteration: El tallaga mesh shaghala wa el mayya fi kol hetta.

examples.arabic: انا بدخل المطبخ الصبح وبلاقي ميه كتير على الارض
examples.english: I enter the kitchen in the morning and find a lot of water on the floor.
examples.transliteration: ana badkhol el matbakh el sobh we balaqi mayya keteer ala el ard

examples.arabic: انت حط شوية ميه هنا لو سمحت
examples.english: You put a little water here please.
examples.transliteration: Enta hott shwayet mayya hena law samaht.
